nodes.statement: A periodic Nvme::read poll starts evaluation of each configured drive.
The flow requires a configured NVMe slot with present and power-good GPIO definitions or defaults.
Nvme::read enters the per-drive GPIO and inventory update path.
Nvme::read derives GPIO paths and reads present and power-good signals before branching on presence.
Each GPIO read opens an input stream for the configured value path.
The GPIO helper owns its input stream while reading the pin value.
The local GPIO input stream is closed when the helper returns its sampled value.
A present drive with power-good false latches the power error and records a failure sample.
The power-bad branch requests fault LED on, locate LED off, and inventory Present true through the serial-gated helper.
Power-good false skips SMBus access, emits the failure temperature, and advances the SMBus error count to its retry limit.
When power-good returns, Nvme::read clears the power-error latch and re-enters readNvmeData with SMBus enabled.
D-Bus clients observe the requested LED state, sensor availability equal to power-good, and serial-gated inventory updates.
The source oracle covers GPIO sampling, the present/power-bad branch, helper write gates, and power-good recovery.

edges.statement: Each poll enumerates the configured slot and its GPIO settings before reading state.
A configured drive slot is processed by Nvme::read.
Nvme::read calls the GPIO helper for present and power-good inputs before its presence branch.
The GPIO helper opens the configured value file to sample the pin.
The helper retains the opened stream until the value has been read.
Returning the sampled GPIO value ends ownership of the local stream.
The completed present and power-good samples determine whether the power-bad latch is set.
Entering the present/power-bad state requests the declared LED and inventory updates.
The same power-bad branch propagates failure through the sensor sample and SMBus retry state.
A later power-good sample clears the latched error and restores the SMBus read path.
Recovery updates the externally visible sensor availability and subsequent drive state.
The source ranges bind the observable inventory, LED, and sensor outcomes to each branch.

disconfirming_checks.statement: The power-bad path for a detected drive passes Present true to the inventory helper; it is not the absent-drive branch.
The inventory helper writes Present and asset fields only when the sampled serial differs from the cached serial.
